ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the vertices of $\triangle ABC$ are all located on the grid points of a square grid. Then, what is the value of $\sin\angle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect CD\\
$\because$ $BC=\sqrt{1+3^2}=\sqrt{10}$, $CD=\sqrt{1+1}=\sqrt{2}$, $BD=\sqrt{2^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{2}$\\
$\therefore$ $BC^2=CD^2+BD^2$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BDC=90^\circ$\\
$\therefore$ $\sin\angle ABC=\frac{CD}{BC}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{10}}=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{5}}{5}}$
